metaTitle: Best Table Lamp Sets (2026): 6 Picks Compared
metaDescription: Six matching table lamp sets of two compared on height, base material, shade, color temperature, outlets and style, with honest tradeoffs for bedrooms.
expertTake: The Seealle 23 inch modern ceramic pair is the best overall pick for its clean beige-white glaze at a size that fits most nightstands, while the 22 inch farmhouse pair is the value pick with a stated 60W maximum. The BOBOMOMO 27 inch travertine-look pair suits sofa consoles that need height. Anyone who needs USB charging at both bedsides or who wants a touch dimmer should look at a touch lamp set instead of a decorative pair.
introParagraphs: A pair of matching table lamps gives a bedroom or living room symmetry, with one lamp on each side of a bed, a sofa or a console. The effect is calm and balanced, and buying a set ensures the finish and shade match exactly, which is harder to achieve with two singles.

The decisions are scale, material and function: how tall each lamp is against the table, whether the base is ceramic, resin or metal, whether bulbs and outlets are included, and how the shade shapes the light. This guide compares six table lamp sets and says plainly when a decorative pair will not do the job.

products.name: Seealle 23 Inch Modern Ceramic Table Lamps Set of 2, Beige-White Glaze
products.description:
Seealle's pair has a 23 inch height, a ceramic base with metal fittings and a beige-white glaze, packaged with minimal materials. At 23 inches, each lamp suits a nightstand in the common 24 to 28 inch height range, so the shade sits near eye level when you sit up in bed.

A ceramic body gives the lamps weight and a quiet colour, and a beige-white glaze fits most bedding and wall colours. The tradeoff is function: the listing mentions no USB ports, dimmer or touch control in the data we reviewed, so these are plain on and off lamps. Against the Reaketon, the Seealle is lighter in colour and slightly taller. Against the BOBOMOMO, it is shorter and smoother.

Place the lamps symmetrically and keep the shade bottom near eye level when seated. Use warm 2700K LED bulbs within the socket wattage, and consider dimmable bulbs with a lamp dimmer if you want dimming. Wipe the glaze with a barely damp cloth and dust the shades with a lint roller. Tighten the harps after the first month. Buy a spare bulb of the same type.
products.bestFor: Bedrooms and living rooms that want a calm, matched, modern ceramic pair.
pros: A 23 inch height suits most nightstands and side tables
A beige-white ceramic glaze blends with most bedding and wall colours
A matched pair gives exact finish and shade symmetry
Ceramic gives each lamp enough weight to sit steadily
cons: No USB, dimmer or touch control is listed in the data we reviewed
Ceramic can chip if a lamp is knocked over

products.name: Farmhouse Table Lamps Set of 2, 22 Inch, Rustic Distressed Accents, 60W Maximum

specList.label: Rooms
specList.value: Bedroom, living room, night stands, end tables

products.description:
This farmhouse pair stands 22 inches tall with distressed accents in a vintage style, and the listing states a maximum of 60W per bulb. A stated bulb limit is useful, because exceeding it overheats fabric shades, and 60W is a typical limit for a small lamp.

The pair is aimed at night stands and end tables, and the 22 inch height suits both. The tradeoff is brand clarity: the product title carries no brand name in the data we reviewed, so check the seller, warranty and return terms on the listing page. Against the Seealle, it is rustic rather than modern. Against the PARTPHONER, it is a similar style with a clearer stated bulb limit.

Use LED bulbs well under 60W, since LEDs run cooler and a 9W LED gives about the brightness of a traditional 60W bulb. Place the lamps with the shade clear of curtains. Wipe distressed finishes with a dry cloth to avoid stripping the effect. Tighten the shade fitting after a month. Keep the cords tidy, and replace any bulbs with the same base type.
products.bestFor: Farmhouse bedrooms and living rooms that want a matched rustic pair at a low cost tier.
pros: A stated 60W maximum bulb gives a clear safety limit for the shade
A 22 inch height suits both night stands and end tables
Distressed accents give a vintage farmhouse look
A matched pair gives symmetry for a bed or sofa
cons: The listing title shows no brand, so check seller and warranty details

products.name: BOBOMOMO Modern Table Lamp Set of 2, 27.25 Inch, Warm Beige Resin with Stone Finish

specList.label: Material
specList.value: Resin with hand-applied stone finish, not real travertine

products.description:
BOBOMOMO's pair is 27.25 inches tall, made of resin with a hand-applied stone finish that the listing states is not real travertine, in a warm beige with a clean cone base. The honesty about material is helpful: a travertine look at a resin weight and cost, which is lighter to move and kinder to a table.

At 27.25 inches, these are tall lamps, suited to consoles, sideboards and large side tables behind a sofa, and they suit modern, boho and farmhouse styles. The tradeoff is scale: they can overpower a standard nightstand, and resin can chip or show a lighter colour underneath if scratched. Against the Seealle, they are taller and heavier in look. Against the Reaketon, they are warmer and more textured.

Place them on a table at least 30 inches high or on a console behind a sofa. Use warm LED bulbs. Avoid abrasive cleaners, and wipe with a dry or slightly damp cloth. Check the stability of the cone base by pressing gently on the top before leaving the lamp unattended, since a narrow top on a wide base is stable but a tall shade can catch a sleeve. Keep cords tidy behind the console.
products.bestFor: Sofa consoles and tall side tables that want a warm, stone-look pair with height.
pros: At 27.25 inches the pair suits consoles and tall side tables
A hand-applied stone finish gives a travertine look at a lighter resin weight
A clean cone base suits modern, boho and farmhouse rooms
The listing states plainly that the finish is not real travertine
cons: At 27.25 inches the lamps can overpower a standard nightstand
Resin can chip and show colour underneath if scratched

products.name: Reaketon Modern Ceramic Table Lamps Set of 2, 20 Inch, Dark Blue, 3000K Fabric Shade
products.description:
Reaketon's pair of dark blue ceramic lamps stands 20 inches tall with a 4.3 inch base diameter and a fabric shade that gives a 3000K warm light. A 4.3 inch base is slim, so the lamps leave space on a narrow nightstand, and a deep blue glaze adds colour to a neutral bedroom without a large painted surface.

A saturated colour makes the lamps a focal point, which suits a bedroom that already has a calm palette. The tradeoff is the slim base: it is easier to knock over than a jar, and dark glazes show dust and fingerprints. Against the Seealle, the Reaketon is smaller and darker. Against the ZJOJO, it is a ceramic pair with a fabric shade instead of a small utility lamp.

Place the lamps at the back of the nightstand with the cord behind the table. Use a 3000K LED bulb to match the shade's warm tone, and keep the wattage within the socket tag. Wipe the glaze with a soft cloth, and dust the shade with a lint roller. If you also read in bed, add a separate reading light.
products.bestFor: Calm bedrooms that want a deep blue accent in a slim matched pair.

A 4.3 inch base leaves room on a narrow nightstand

products.name: PARTPHONER Traditional Table Lamp Set of 2, 22 Inch, Rustic Farmhouse, Linen Shades

specList.label: Shade
specList.value: Linen for a softer, eye-friendly light

products.description:
PARTPHONER's pair is a traditional 22 inch rustic farmhouse set with an antique finish and linen shades chosen to soften the light and ease eye strain, per the listing. Linen is a natural-fibre fabric that diffuses light into a warm glow, and the antique finish gives the lamps an older, collected look.

A traditional style suits cottage, farmhouse and classic bedrooms, but may look dated in a minimalist room. The tradeoff is cleaning: linen shades gather dust and show marks, and an antique finish can wear at the edges. Against the unbranded 22 inch farmhouse pair, it states a linen shade and a brand. Against the Seealle, it is more rustic and less modern.

Use warm LED bulbs and check the socket wattage on the tag. Keep the shades clear of curtains and place the lamps symmetrically. Dust the linen with a lint roller or soft brush and avoid wet cleaning. Wipe the base with a dry cloth. Tighten the fittings after a month and keep a spare bulb on hand.

products.name: ZJOJO Table Lamps Set of 2, 13.8 Inch Small Bedside, AC Outlet, 3 Colour Temperatures
products.description:
ZJOJO's pair is 13.8 inches tall, takes any E26 bulb, has a rocker switch that changes among three colour temperatures and a built-in two-prong AC outlet on each lamp. The outlet is the standout: it gives a socket for a phone charger at the bedside without a separate power strip.

At 13.8 inches the lamps are compact, which suits small nightstands, desks and shelves but gives a low shade that may glare when you sit up in bed. The tradeoff is that a two-prong outlet fits only two-prong plugs, so a three-prong charger will not fit, and a small lamp throws less ambient light. Against the Reaketon at 20 inches, the ZJOJO is much smaller but more functional. Against the Seealle, it is a utility lamp rather than a design piece.

Check the outlet's load limit on the label, and avoid plugging in high-draw devices. Choose warm for bedtime and cooler for tasks. Place the lamps where the low shade does not shine in your eyes. Fits any E26 bulb, but keep to the maximum wattage on the socket tag. Wipe with a dry cloth and keep the outlets free of dust.

buyingCriteria.explanation: Lamps should look in proportion to the table. About 20 to 24 inches suits a nightstand, and 27 inches or more suits a console. The Seealle's 23 inches suits most bedsides, and the BOBOMOMO's 27.25 inches suits a console. Keep the shade bottom near eye level when seated.

Ceramic, as on the Seealle and Reaketon, is heavy and quiet in colour but can chip. Resin, as on the BOBOMOMO, is lighter and imitates stone, as the listing states. Metal bases are slim and sturdy. Choose by weight, finish and the risk of knocks.
Linen and fabric shades diffuse light into a warm glow. They give ambient light, not a focused reading beam. If you read in bed, choose a taller lamp or add a separate task light.

Check the maximum wattage on the socket tag, as the farmhouse 22 inch pair states 60W. Use warm 2700K to 3000K LEDs for bedrooms. The ZJOJO's three colour temperatures add flexibility if you also use the lamp for tasks.
A built-in outlet, as on the ZJOJO, adds a socket at the bedside. Most decorative pairs have none. If USB charging matters, look at touch lamp sets rather than a purely decorative pair.

A set guarantees matched shades and finishes. Hand-applied finishes, like the BOBOMOMO's stone look, vary slightly between lamps. Buy both lamps from one order, and check return terms in case one arrives chipped.

maintenance.why: Dust dims light and marks linen. A lint roller or soft brush is safe.
A dry or barely damp cloth removes dust and fingerprints. Avoid abrasive cleaners on distressed finishes.
Use LEDs within the socket tag. A hot bulb under fabric is a fire risk.
A loose finial lets the shade wobble. Tighten by hand.
Cords get pinched behind furniture. A damaged cord should be replaced.

faq.q: What size lamps do I need for a nightstand?
faq.a: About 20 to 24 inches suits most nightstands. The shade bottom should sit near eye level when you are seated.

faq.q: Can I use brighter bulbs in a decorative lamp?
faq.a: Only within the socket's maximum wattage. LEDs run cooler, so a low-watt LED can match a higher-watt incandescent.

faq.q: Are lamp sets better than buying two lamps?
faq.a: A set guarantees matched finish and shades, and often costs less per lamp. Singles give more variety.

faq.q: Is resin as good as ceramic?
faq.a: Resin is lighter and can imitate stone, while ceramic is heavier with a glaze. Both can chip, so place them carefully.
It helps for evenings. Use dimmable bulbs with a lamp or wall dimmer, and avoid mixing non-dimmable bulbs.

faq.q: Can I read by a decorative lamp?
faq.a: Weakly. Fabric shades give ambient light, so add a focused reading light if you read in bed.
